name: usrp-ui
description: Unified Security Recruitment Portal — Frontend Monorepo (RDF/RNP/RCS)
author: Jackson NSANZIMANA

scripts.//affected: turbo's affected-graph filtering keeps CI fast. It compares against the merge base, so it needs full git history — every CI job using these sets fetch-depth: 0.
scripts.//gates: Every gate is a script that runs identically here and in CI. There is no CI-only variant that can drift. Thresholds live in tooling/repo-hygiene/gates.config.json.
scripts.//verify: The full local gate, mirroring the backend's `pnpm verify`. Run this before pushing and CI will hold no surprises.
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:rules && pnpm verify:hygiene && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm build && pnpm verify:extraction && pnpm size && pnpm a11y
scripts.//proof: Demonstrates that every gate FAILS on a planted violation and PASSES once removed. Run it whenever you change a gate; a gate nobody has seen fail is a gate nobody should trust.
scripts.//purge: Dry run only. The history rewrite is an owner decision — read tooling/repo-hygiene/PURGE-RUNBOOK.md first.
